author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಬ್ಬಹರಿದಿನವುಂಟು ಪಿತೃನಮನಗಳಿಹವು
ದಿಬ್ಬಣವು ಶವಯಾತ್ರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಿಹವು
ಮಬ್ಬುಹರಿದಿರೆ ಹುಟ್ಟು ಮರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮರಣಗುರಿ
ನಿಬ್ಬೆರಗು ಜಗಸೃಷ್ಟಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There are feasts and holy days, there are homages to the ancestors;
wedding processions and funeral processions are both commonplace;
as the haze lifts there is birth, and the very next moment death is the goal:
the making of the world leaves one speechless, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Festivals and rites for the ancestors, weddings and funerals, all sit side by side in ordinary life. Death follows so closely on birth. The way the world is made should leave us in silent wonder.
